spans.s: कुट् (I) vt. 6P (pp. कुटित) 1. To curve, to bend; 2. to act dishonestly, to cheat.
कुट् (II) vi. 4P (pres. कुट्यति) To break into pieces, to break asunder.
कुट्ट् vt. 10U (pp. कुट्टित) 1. To cut, to divide; 2. to grind; 3. to blame, to censure.
कुट (I) m.n. A water pot, a jar.
कुट (II) m. 1. A fort, a stronghold; 2. a hammer; 3. a tree; 4. a mountain.
कूट (I) a. (f. टा) 1. False, e.g. कूटाः स्युर्पूर्वसाक्षिणः; 2. immoveable, steady.

कूट (II) m.n. 1. The bone of the forehead with its projections, the crown of the head; 2. a prominence in general; 3. a horn; 4. end, corner, Yaj.iii.96; 5. a summit or peak of a mountain, शैलादाशु त्रिनयनवृषोत्खातकूटान्निवृत्तः Megh.ii.50, R.iv.71; 6. head, chief; 7. a heap, a multitude, e.g. अभ्रकूट ‘a multitude of clouds,’ अन्नकूट ‘a heap of food’; 8. a hammer, an iron-mallet; 9. a plough-share, the body of a plough; 10. a trap for catching deer; 11. a concealed weapon, as a dagger in a woollen case or a sword in a stick; 12. illusion, fraud; 13. a roguish scheme, a trick; 14. a knotty point, a puzzling question; 15. untruth, falsehood; 16. a water-jar.
कूट (III) m. 1. A house, a dwelling; 2. an epithet of Agastya.
कूट (I) a. (f. टा) 1. False, e.g. कूटाः स्युर्पूर्वसाक्षिणः; 2. immoveable, steady.
कुट-हारिका f. a female servant.
कुट-ज m. 1. name of a tree, Megh.i.4, R.xix.37,
Ghat.13
; 2. a name of Agastya; 3. of Droṇa.
कुटक n. A plough without a pole.
कुट्टाक a. (f. की) Who or what divides or cuts, इभकुंभकूटकुट्टाकपाणिकुलिशस्य हरेः प्रमादः M.M.v.
कूटक n. 1. Elevation, prominence; 2. the body of a plough, a plough-share; 3. fraud, deceit.
कुटंक m. A roof, a thatch.
कुटंगक m. 1. An arbour formed by creeping plants overrunning a tree, a small house; 2. a thatch.
कुटप (I) m. 1. A measure of grain; 2. a garden near a house; 3. a sage, an ascetic.
कुटप (II) n. A lotus.
कुटर m. The post round which the string of the churning stick winds.
कुट्टार (I) m. A mountain.
कुट्टार (II) n. 1. Sexual intercourse; 2. a woollen blanket.
कुटल n. A roof, a thatch.
कुटि (I) m. 1. The body; 2. a tree.
कुटि (II) f. A cottage, a hut.
कुटी f. 1. a curve; 2. a cottage, a hut, [Amar. gives कुट in masculine] M.xi.72; 3. a bawd, a procuress.
कुटि-चर m. a porpoise.
कुटी-चर m. an ascetic of a particular order who consigns the care of his family to his son and remains engaged solely in devotions.
कुटिर n. A cottage, a hut.
कुटीर m.n. A hut, a cottage, Am.
कुटिल a. (f. ला) 1. Crooked, bent, curved, curled, R.vi.82, xix.17; 2. tortuous; 9. insincere, fraudulent, dishonest.
कुटिल a. (f. ला) 1. Crooked, bent, curved, curled, R.vi.82, xix.17; 2. tortuous; 9. insincere, fraudulent, dishonest.
कुटिल-आशय a. malevolent.
कुटिल-पक्ष्मन् a. having curved eyelashes.
कुटिल-स्वभाव a. dishonest, malevolent.
कुटिलिका f. 1. Coming stealthily as a hunter on his prey; 2. a blacksmith’s forge.
कुटी-चक m. a religious mendicant of a particular order (चतुर्विधा ब् हिक्षवस्ते कुटीचकबहूदकौ । हंसः परमहंशश्च योऽत्र पश्चात् स उत्तमः Bh.).
कुटीरक m. A hut, a cottage, Am.
कुटुनी f. A bawd, a procuress.
कुटुंब (I) n. 1. House-hold, a family, Yaj.ii.45, M.xi.22; 2. the duties and cares of a family, तदुपहितकुटुंबः R.vii.71.
कुटुंब (I) n. 1. House-hold, a family, Yaj.ii.45, M.xi.22; 2. the duties and cares of a family, तदुपहितकुटुंबः R.vii.71.
कुटुंबक (II) m.n. 1. A kinsman, a relation by descent or marriage; 2. offspring, progeny; 3. a name.
कुटुंब-कलह m.n. domestic disunion.
कुटुंब-कलह m.n. domestic disunion.
कुटुंब-भर m. the burden of the family, भर्त्रा तदर्पितकुटुंबभरेण सार्धम् Sak.iv.
कुटुंब-भर m. the burden of the family, भर्त्रा तदर्पितकुटुंबभरेण सार्धम् Sak.iv.
कुटुंब-व्यापृत a. provident and attentive to the welfare of the family.
कुटुंब-व्यापृत a. provident and attentive to the welfare of the family.
कुटुंबिक m. A householder, a pater familias, one who has a family to take care of, सर्वः कल्ये वयसि यतते कब्धुमर्थान् कुटुंबी Vikr.iii., Yaj.ii.45, K.S.vi.85.
कुटुंबिक m. A householder, a pater familias, one who has a family to take care of, सर्वः कल्ये वयसि यतते कब्धुमर्थान् कुटुंबी Vikr.iii., Yaj.ii.45, K.S.vi.85.
कुटुंबिनी f. 1. The wife of a householder and generally in charge of the house, अपशोकमनाः कुटुंबिनीमनुगृह्णीष्व निवापदत्तिभिः R.viii.86, Am.
; 2. a woman in general; 3. a multitude of families.
कुट्टन n. 1. Cutting; 2. pounding; 3. abusing.
कुट्ट(ट्टि)नी f. A bawd, a procuress, a go-between.
कुट्ट(ट्टि)नी f. A bawd, a procuress, a go-between.

कुट्टमित n. One of the ten blandishments of women, viz., affected repulse of a lover’s caresses. (It is thus defined in the S.D.- केशस्तनाधरादीनां ग्रहे हर्षेऽपि संभ्रमात् । प्राहुः कुट्टमितं नाम शिरःकराविधूननम् ॥)
कुट्टाक a. (f. की) Who or what divides or cuts, इभकुंभकूटकुट्टाकपाणिकुलिशस्य हरेः प्रमादः M.M.v.
कुट्टिम m.n. 1. An inlaid or paved floor, ground paved with mosaic, R.xi.9; 2. ground prepared for the cite of a mansion; 3. a jewel mine; 4. a cottage, a small house; 5. the pomegranate plant.
कुट्टिहारिका f. A maid servant.
कुट्मल m.n. The same as कुड्मल q.v.
कूट-अक्ष m. a loaded or false die, कूटाक्षोपधिदेविनः Yaj.ii.202.
कूट-अगार n. an apartment on the top of a house.
कूट-अर्थ m. ambiguity of meaning.
कूट-अर्थ˚भाषा f. a tale, a fiction.
कूट-उपाय m. a trick, a stratagem.
कूट-कार m. a rogue, a false witness.
कूट-कृत् (I) a. 1. cheating, bribing; 2. forging a document, Yaj.ii.70.
कूट-कृत् (II) m. 1. a man of the writer caste (कायस्थ); 2. an epithet of Śiva.
कूट-कार्षापण m. a false कार्षापण q.v.
कूट-खड्ग m. a swordstick.
कूट-च्छद्मन् m. a cheat.
कूट-तुला f. a false pair of scales.
कूट-धर्म a. (a country or house) where falsehood is considered a duty.
कूट-पाकल m. bilious fever to which eleplants are subject, अचिरेण वैकृतविवर्तदारुणः कलभं कठोर इव कूटपाकलः M.M.i.
कूट-पालक m. a potter.
कूट-पाश, -बंध m. a trap, R.xiii.39.
कूट-पाश, -बंध m. a trap, R.xiii.39.
कूट-मान n. a false measure, a false weight.
कूट-मोहन m. an epithet of Skanda.
कूट-यंत्र n. a trap, a snare for deer, birds &c.
कूट-युद्ध n. treacherous or unfair warfare.
कूट-शस् ind. in heaps, in multitudes.
कूट-शाल्मलि f. 1. a species of the śālmalī tree; 2. the club of Yama, R.xii.95.
कूट-शासन n. a forged grant or decree.
कूट-साक्षिन् m. a false witness.
कूट-स्थ (I) a. standing at the top, keeping the highest position (used of a person who stands at the head in a genealogical table).
कूट-स्थ (II) m. the supreme soul (immoveable, uniform and perpetually the same).
कूट-स्वर्ण n. counterfeit gold.
कूटक-आख्यान n. an invented tale.
